$description: Tier 3 — Button-only tokens. Glow shadows read --btn-color, the color the Button sets from its `color` prop, so they live in @theme inline and resolve on the button itself.

button-glow.$value: 0 0 8px 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--btn-color) 50%, transparent), 0 0 24px 6px color-mix(in oklch, var(--btn-color) 22%, transparent)

button-glow-hover.$value: 0 0 12px 4px color-mix(in oklch, var(--btn-color) 65%, transparent), 0 0 36px 10px color-mix(in oklch, var(--btn-color) 30%, transparent)

button-glow-active.$value: 0 0 5px 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--btn-color) 40%, transparent), 0 0 14px 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--btn-color) 18%, transparent)

button-surface.$value: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.35), inset 0 -1px 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.25), inset 1px 0 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.15), inset -1px 0 0 oklch(0 0 0 / 0.12)
